hint.label: Archaeologist
hint.text: An archaeologist is someone who looks at ancient sites and artefacts to learn about the past.

atoms.b: Sutton Hoo is an Anglo-Saxon ((++burial aerial)) site that was discovered in 1939 by archaeologists.
atoms.sound: SuttonHoo, is an Anglo-Saxon burial site that was discovered in 1939 by archaeologists.

atoms.b: Archaeologists discovered the imprint of a huge wooden ((rocket ++ship)). Inside, they found a king’s grave that was full of treasures.

instruction.text: Find the treasures that were found at Sutton Hoo.

feedback.finish: Inside the king’s grave, archaeologists found treasures including weapons, armour and jewellery.

instruction.text: Read the extract from Beowulf’s funeral and answer the questions.
instruction.sound: Read the extract from Bayowolf’s funeral and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
“Then they laid down their beloved prince,
the dispenser of rings, in the bosom of the ship,
the notorious by the mast. There were many treasures,
brought from far-aways, adornments laden there —”

atoms.a: What two similarities can you see between this funeral and the Sutton Hoo grave?
Where did these treasures come from?

feedback.end: Just like in the poem, some treasures from Sutton Hoo came from different countries. While the story of Beowulf is fictional, Sutton Hoo provides evidence that the funeral described reflects real Anglo-Saxon traditions.

instruction.text: Were these part of Anglo-Saxon reality or fiction?
